xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4658: Cite selected text in the EditorPane markdown preview

plan.title: Cite selected text in the EditorPane markdown preview
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-4642 lets the operator cite selected conversation text into the next prompt, but the Stage editor pane's markdown Preview cannot cite: an editor tab has no notion of which conversation's composer should receive the citation, and the citation type, store validation, serializer and cite layer only know message citations.
narratives.Proposal: Record the origin conversation on the editor pane when a conversation's file chip opens it (CitationTargetContext provided by MessagesTimeline, gated on citationsEnabled; re-focus from another conversation re-targets; null never clears). Add a { kind: 'file'; path } citation source accepted by the store, serialize file citations as one 'Notes on `<path>`:' block per path after the unchanged reply block, generalize CiteSelectionLayer with a selection resolver and onSaved callback, and mount it over the editor Preview (hidden in Edit, without a target, or while dirty) with a toast that opens the target conversation. Chips show the file name, pending quotes highlight in the Preview, and archiving a conversation clears it as a cite target. Exact bytes, signatures and tests are in .pan/drafts/PAN-4658.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Citing in the Stage BrowserPane (sandboxed iframe; #2685)
- Citing from the Edit textarea, or while the editor draft has unsaved changes
- A target-conversation picker, or guessing a target (most recently active conversation) for editor tabs with no origin
- Giving editor tabs opened from issue-overview, PRD-viewer or other non-conversation markdown a cite target
- Mapping a rendered-text quote back to raw markdown source or line numbers
- Any server, contracts, delivery-path change, or any edit to ConversationPanel.tsx
- Cross-window live sync of pending citations
- Changing the message-citation format, row gate, chips or highlight behavior

autoDecisions.summary: The cite target is the conversation whose file chip opened (or last re-focused) the editor pane, stored as WorkspacePane.citeConversationName.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is deterministic and testable; the 'most recently active conversation' candidate can silently send a note to the wrong agent, and a picker is new UI the issue does not require. MarkdownFileLink is the only caller of openOrFocusEditorPane, so recording at that call site covers every path.

autoDecisions.summary: Editor panes with no recorded origin show no Cite button.
autoDecisions.rationale: No guessing of a destination agent; tabs opened from issue-overview or PRD markdown simply opt out.

autoDecisions.summary: The origin is provided by MessagesTimeline via CitationTargetContext, valued only when citationsEnabled.
autoDecisions.rationale: MessagesTimeline already receives the PAN-4642/PAN-4681 composer gate, so read-only and subagent transcripts record no target, and ConversationPanel.tsx (11 lines under its file-size cap) is untouched.

autoDecisions.summary: Re-opening a file from a different conversation re-targets the existing pane; a null origin never clears a target.
autoDecisions.rationale: Latest conversational intent wins, while browsing from non-conversation surfaces cannot wipe a deliberate target.

autoDecisions.summary: File citations serialize as one 'Notes on `<absolute path>`:' block per path, after the unchanged 'Notes on your previous reply:' block.
autoDecisions.rationale: The reply header is wrong for file quotes; grouping states each path once; keeping message output byte-identical protects PAN-4642's contract for every harness.

autoDecisions.summary: Cite is hidden while the editor draft is dirty.
autoDecisions.rationale: Preview renders the unsaved draft; a quote the agent cannot find on disk is a misleading citation.

autoDecisions.summary: Saving a file citation shows a toast with an 'Open conversation' action (StageDeckContext gains openOrFocusAgentPane).
autoDecisions.rationale: The target conversation is usually another tab, so the operator otherwise gets no visible confirmation.

autoDecisions.summary: Include highlight parity, chip file labels, and archive-time target clearing.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each is a small leaf that keeps file citations behaving like PAN-4642 message citations and prevents citations reaching an archived conversation; the plan stays at 24 files.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend the existing EditorPane, MarkdownFileLink and panesStore test files and add them to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt.
autoDecisions.rationale: All three pass on this branch (66 tests, verified 2026-11-01); listing them is the only way the new assertions run in CI.

metadata.sizeJustification: 24 files across one frontend subsystem plus docs and the CI test list; every item is a small vertical slice of one feature that cannot ship usefully in parts.
